verdict.rationale: Supabase's llms.txt lists per-language reference corpora for agents (js, dart, swift, kotlin, python, csharp), which points to official multi-language client libraries. Other docs reference client-library support (image transformations) and type-safe generated definitions (`database.types.ts`). A Management API OpenAPI spec is also published for programmatic builds. missing for 10: a direct first-party SDK overview with install and usage docs, explicit statement of which SDKs are officially maintained versus community, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
